rules.title: House rules
rules.intro: To keep our mosque and halls pleasant and respectful for everyone, we ask you to observe the following rules.
items: Enter the mosque with clean shoes and in appropriate clothing.
Keep the spaces tidy and dispose of waste in the designated bins.
Respect the quiet during prayer and lectures.
Do not use phones or disruptive devices during prayer.
Smoking is not permitted inside the buildings.
Respect the property of the mosque and of other visitors.
Children remain under the supervision of their parents or guardian.
Follow the instructions of the board and volunteers.
rules.note: Failure to observe the rules may lead to refusal of entry.
